about: The `gross_wages` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is part 3 of 3 for fy 2024.

rows.name: WITHERS MICHELLE
rows.reconciliation: 17 of 17 money figures printed on the page are captured, each paired with a name on its own printed row. A wage list prints no total, so this proves COVERAGE and the pairing, not the digits. Read by textract
